contentPattern.structure: two-column: heading + intro paragraph | stacked contact list (label + value)

suitableFor: contact / 'get in touch' sections with a lead-in on one side and contact details on the other
two-column text layouts pairing an intro with a labeled list (email, phone, address)
side-by-side informational content with no imagery
notSuitableFor: side-by-side image + text feature blocks (use columns-media)
